title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A 3D printer assistant has 800 tokens of instructions and tool descriptions. The student's question is 50 tokens. Call 1 returns a 100-token tool request, the tool result is 250 tokens, and call 2 sends the whole history again. How many input tokens does call 2 contain?
On Monday a student tells the assistant they passed the laser cutter safety test. On Friday they open a new session and the assistant has no notes tool. What happens?

options.text: It recalls Monday because the model kept the chat history
It cannot know, since Monday's window ended with that session
It looks the fact up in what it learned in training
It finds it, because the program re-sends old histories

items.stem: A 400,000-token set of manuals must answer a question using one paragraph. Which plan fits the lesson's advice best?

options.text: Split it into chunks, search them, and add the few best matches
Paste all of it into every call, since the window is large enough
Summarize all of it once and never load the original again
Save all of it in the notes file and load that each session

items.stem: Name the three places an agent's information can live, as the lesson sorts them, and give one example of what belongs in each for the makerspace assistant.
A student asks about error code 'H-17' and a meaning-based search returns only general troubleshooting pages. In one sentence, what kind of search would you add, and why?
